mentions.name: Markdown Notepad Replacement
mentions.description: A lightweight text editor intended as a replacement for MS Notepad, adding Markdown support while staying free of the bloat of Notion and Obsidian for simple editing use cases.
mentions.problem: MS Notepad's built-in Markdown support isn't great, and full-featured editors like Notion and Obsidian feel like bloat for simple editing use cases.
mentions.source_excerpt: A replacement for MS Notepad but with Markdown support. (I know Notepad sort of added this but it isn't great.) It's the tool I want to have when I say, "I like the way I can edit things in Notion and Obsidian but 95% of the functionality of those apps feel like bloat for my use case".
